description: BatterySense is an open-source software project listed in Awesome Sustainable Technology, a curated list of open-source sustainability projects under the section "Battery", published or maintained by rlogiacco (repository owner; maintainers as on the project page). This is a simple Arduino library to monitor battery consumption of your battery powered projects, being LiPo, LiIon, NiCd or any other battery type, single or multiple cells: if it can power your Arduino you can monitor it! Coverage: not geographically bound. The list files it under "Battery" (battery storage). The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (repository not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support battery storage studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-sustainable-technology.
